items.question: Which four kalās are named to conclude this enumerated sequence of powers?
premises: The preceding verses enumerate a series of kalās.
Jñānāmṛtā is named as one of these kalās.
Āpyāyanī, Vyāpinī, and Vyomarūpikā are named alongside it.
items.inference: The sequence concludes with the kalās Jñānāmṛtā, Āpyāyanī, Vyāpinī, and Vyomarūpikā.
uncertainties: The precise functional distinctions among these kalās are not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: And the kalās are Jñānāmṛtā, Āpyāyanī, Vyāpinī, and Vyomarūpikā.
